documents.text: Halsted L. Ritter Halsted Lockwood Ritter (July 14, 1868 – October 15, 1951) was an American lawyer, judge, and member of the Republican political party. He served in the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida but was impeached and removed from office, only the fourth official to be removed. Ritter was born in Indianapolis, Indiana, in 1868. His sister was Mary Ritter Beard, the wife of Charles A. Beard; both were noted historians.
